evidence.quote: Admission to the degree programme is limited to 125 places. 35 places are reserved for non-EU citizens resident abroad.
After you have passed the entrance exam, if you have not already done so, submit the pre-enrolment application online on Universitaly.

note.fr: L'admission est limitée à 125 places, dont 35 réservées aux citoyens non-UE résidant à l'étranger. Vérifiez le nombre de places et la procédure dans l'appel à candidatures.
note.en: Admission is limited to 125 places, 35 of which are reserved for non-EU citizens resident abroad. Check the number of places and the procedure in the call for applications.

evidence.quote: Admission to the degree programme is limited to 125 places. 35 places are reserved for non-EU citizens resident abroad.

note.fr: L'admission se fait sur la base du test SAT General (en anglais, géré par CollegeBoard). Le score minimum pour être admis est de 1100.
note.en: Admission is based on the SAT General test (in English, managed by CollegeBoard). The minimum score to be admitted is 1100.

evidence.quote: The selection of applicants is based on the SAT General test, which is an international test in English managed by CollegeBoard , and stands for “Scholastic Assessment Test.”
The minimum score to be admitted to EPOS is 1100.

note.fr: Vous devez avoir un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires obtenu après au moins douze années de scolarité, donnant accès à l'université en Italie.
note.en: You must hold a secondary school diploma obtained after at least twelve years of schooling, granting access to university in Italy.

evidence.quote: Qualification obtained abroad at the end of a school period of at least twelve years, granting access to university training in Italy in accordance with Italian regulations, current international agreements and the provisions of the MUR circular "Procedures for entry, stay and enrolment of international students and the relative recognition of qualifications, for academic Higher Education courses published on the Universitaly website.
internationally recognized certificates proving at least a B2 level according to the CEFR, in the language of your degree programme

notes: Visa application dates were ignored. The Italian language requirement was not included: the programme is taught in English and the pages only state the Italian requirement for programmes taught in Italian. The language proficiency rule concerns the language of the degree programme (English for this programme) and is stated as a possible document the Embassy or Consulate may request. The tuition fee for this programme could not be identified from the supplied pages: they only explain exemptions and reduced-fee systems (ISEE-based, nationality-based) without stating the amount that applies to a Moroccan citizen with a household outside Italy for this programme; the reduced fixed fee for non-OECD countries mentions a list that includes Morocco, but no quote gives the applicable amount for a non-EU student tied to this programme.
